chemical_assertion_review.new_scope_checks: Require exactly two source-assertion edges and exact ID set {carrier#recipe/1, mediadive.solution:1#recipe/1}; carrier must point to CHEBI7070 and retain its exact explicit synthetic raw record.
chemical_assertion_review.no_silent_filter: The extra carrier edge is asserted before selection; no edge is silently discarded to obtain the original count.
chemical_assertion_review.original_assertions: After exact target-ID selection, all original target count/object/value/unit/raw-record assertions remain, as do exactly one CHEBI node, canonical xref and old-alias/new-annotation lookup boundary assertions.

fresh_checkpoint_review.actual_loader: MediaDiveTransform._load_bulk_data() constructs a new EndpointConsumer and parses the four required native dictionaries through load_bulk_payload; it does not receive copied endpoint, bulk, recipe or consumed-input guards from the old object.
fresh_checkpoint_review.checkpoint_boundary: MediaDiveTransform.finalize restores endpoint evidence and restore_recipe_checkpoint runs public source validation, rereads the media list and required consumed files, then creates/restores a new recipe guard. The proposal does not prepare recipe evidence ahead of this boundary.
fresh_checkpoint_review.freshness_controls: Distinct endpoint consumer asserted; recipe guard absent and bacdive_taxon_lookup absent before checkpoint restore. Transform.__init__ establishes fresh generic consumption/dependency admission.
fresh_checkpoint_review.negative_controls: Existing six malformed/missing/wrong-source report cases and both source variants for generic restamping remain; public validator, merge admission, fresh repeat-finalize and publication-byte checks remain. The only changed negative helper call initializes the real native reader so rejection reaches evidence validation instead of an absent-object AttributeError.
fresh_checkpoint_review.positive_control: Intact persisted evidence must return the exact recorded report, restore exact consumed/native contracts, create a distinct recipe guard, pass consumed/public/merge validators, and leave every source-output byte unchanged.
fresh_checkpoint_review.scope: Non-MediaDive consumers retain the original Transform-only reconstruction.

limits: Read-only static review and AST/hash comparison only; no proposed code imported or executed.
No tests, gates, producers, HTTP, DB queries, tracked edits or source-data writes performed.
This approval binds the three saved proposals. Actual applied bytes and focused results require the later requested check.
The separately prepared1778BacDive proposal is outside this review.

synthetic_carrier_review.label_origin: Only when compound is absent, require an existing nonempty string name and copy that value to compound on a deep copy of the explicit catalogue claim.
synthetic_carrier_review.preservation: Original files are preserved before derivation; caller catalogue claim is deep copied; target recipe records are copied independently and receive no added fields. Existing compound values are not replaced.
synthetic_carrier_review.semantics: The added field belongs to the explicitly synthetic first-occurrence carrier. This is not a new field claimed for the original target observation or an alteration of scientific source data.
